answer: An identity bond that decays stops a nebula of fake agents lingering. To enter the garden of traders, each agent locks a 20-unit bond shedding 2 units per epoch unless honest work renews it; idle identities bleed out. A river of fresh accounts cannot save an attacker: 100 fakes cost 2000 units up front plus 200 per epoch, against a 900-unit pool. Honest agents pay once and earn it back, so honesty is cheap and farming fakes drains money.
